name: Hammerhead Pipeline
monitor_reason: class: Equitrans itself and Reuters (via Pipeline and Gas Journal) call Hammerhead a gathering header, not a transmission line; GEM gas tracker scope is transmission. Length (about 64 mi) and capacity (1.6 Bcf/d) are sourced and the line is not an existing row (MVP P0220, Greene Interconnect P4456 and Equitrans P6895-P6897 are different assets), so it would qualify on size if a ruling puts gathering headers in scope.
researcher_notes: An Equitrans earnings release from February 2020 says Hammerhead is a gathering header pipeline of about 64 miles from southwestern Pennsylvania to Mobley, West Virginia, where MVP and the Ohio Valley Connector originate. A Reuters story from October 2021 says it feeds about 1.6 Bcf per day into the Mountain Valley pipe, cost about $555 million, and EQT holds a 1.2 Bcf per day commitment. Full in service was tied to MVP start. No FERC certificate was checked. Not found: diameter and a regulator document. Ruling needed on whether gathering headers are in scope. If yes, stage as new row with Equitrans as owner, length 64 mi, capacity 1.6 Bcf/d, status operating only after confirming MVP start-up.
